t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

t: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
d: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

t: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
d: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

t: New Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
d: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

t: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life
d: Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

t: The Twilight Zone: Deaths-Head Revisited
d: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
d: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

t: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
d: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

t: New Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
d: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

t: New Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
d: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

t: New Twilight Zone: Something in the Walls
d: A doctor arrives at his new job in a sanitarium. He discovers the case of a woman who is terribly frightened of things that appear on her walls.

t: New Twilight Zone: Room 2426
d: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Jungle
d: Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.

t: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
d: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

t: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
st: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
d: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
d: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

t: New Twilight Zone: The Mind of Simon Foster
d: In an impoverished future, Simon Foster goes to a pawnshop to sell some personal items to raise money for rent. The shop owner offers to buy some of his memories. In Simon Foster's life, what could be possibly be valuable?

t: New Twilight Zone: The Wall
d: A U.S. military experiment opens a portal to an unknown place. After sending through one team, the Army calls upon a career soldier to investigate, where he finds an idyllic planet. He has to decide whether to stay or go back to his old life.

t: New Twilight Zone: Cat and Mouse
d: A shy woman finds that a cat is actually a cursed "Casanova." She falls for the man but finds that her Prince Charming is actually a scoundrel.

t: New Twilight Zone: Rendezvous in a Dark Place
d: An old woman with an obsession with death attends funerals for entertainment. One night when an injured thief breaks into her home, she lets him die and waits for Death to come and collect him.

t: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
d: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

t: The Twilight Zone: One More Pallbearer
d: Paul Radin has invited three people to join him in his bomb shelter.

t: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
d: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Hunt
d: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

t: New Twilight Zone: Many, Many Monkeys
d: An epidemic breaks out and many people are struck blind. Something more happens, however: People have become cold and heartless toward each other

t: New Twilight Zone: Love Is Blind
d: A man plotting to murder his wife's lover meets a blind singer who seems to know all about his plans.

t: New Twilight Zone: Crazy as a Soup Sandwich
d: A man sells his soul to a demon for some racing tips. After being terrified by the demon he goes for help from the criminal boss he borrowed the track money from

t: New Twilight Zone: Special Service
d: A man finds that his life has been on TV for the past five years

t: The Twilight Zone: Showdown with Rance McGrew
d: Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

t: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
d: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

t: The Twilight Zone: A Piano in the House
d: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
st: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
d: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...

t: The Twilight Zone: The Comedian
d: Comedian Samir Wassan (Kumail Nanjiani) wants to be famous...but at what cost?
